metas.name: The Keepers
metas.description: This docuseries examines the decades-old murder of Sister Catherine Cesnik and its suspected link to a priest accused of abuse.

metas.name: How to Change Your Mind
metas.description: Author Michael Pollan leads the way in this docuseries exploring the history and uses of psychedelics, including LSD, psilocybin, MDMA and mescaline.

metas.name: A Haunting
metas.description: These are the true stories of the innocent and the unimaginable. Based on true events, A Haunting dramatises some of the scariest stories, revealing a world in which tragedy, suicide and murder have left psychic impressions so powerful that innocent people become forced to deal with them decades later. Through mesmerizing first-person accounts, the mystery and origin of each haunting is powerfully revealed and leaves a lingering sense that life—and death—are much stronger then anyone could have possibly imagined.

metas.name: Live to 100: Secrets of the Blue Zones
metas.description: Travel around the world with author Dan Buettner to discover five unique communities where people live extraordinarily long and vibrant lives.

metas.name: Into the Fire: The Lost Daughter
metas.description: A tenacious mother unravels the complex mystery surrounding the 1989 disappearance of the daughter she placed for adoption.

metas.name: Night Stalker: The Hunt for a Serial Killer
metas.description: Beneath the sunlit glamour of 1985 L.A. lurks a relentlessly evil serial killer. In this true-crime story, two detectives won't rest until they catch him.

metas.name: Evil Genius
metas.description: This baffling true crime story starts with the grisly death of a pizza man who robs a bank with a bomb around his neck - and gets weirder from there.

metas.name: Murder on Middle Beach
metas.description: A four-part documentary series revolving around the case of single mother Barbara Hamburg, who was brutally murdered in 2010 near her home in the upper-middle class enclave of Madison, Connecticut. The series presents first-time filmmaker Madison Hamburg’s complicated journey as a young man determined to solve an unspeakable crime and absolve the people he loves, while looking for answers within his fractured family and community.

metas.name: Unsolved Mysteries
metas.description: Real cases of perplexing disappearances, shocking murders and paranormal encounters fuel this gripping revival of the iconic documentary series.

metas.name: Ancient Aliens
metas.description: Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago? From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate.
